description: This file implements the PlayerInfo functionality, including codec support, resolution info, and Dolby output controls within the WPEFramework plugin. It manages device settings, codec detection via GStreamer, and event handling for audio modes.

classes.name: PlayerInfoImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing player properties and Dolby output interface, managing codecs, resolution, and device settings.

classes.name: GstUtils
classes.description: Utility class for GStreamer element and media type checks.

methods.name: PlayerInfoImplementation
methods.description: Constructor initializing codecs, device manager, and event handlers.

methods.name: ~PlayerInfoImplementation
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up codecs and event handlers.

methods.name: AudioCodecs
methods.description: Returns an iterator over supported audio codecs.

methods.name: VideoCodecs
methods.description: Returns an iterator over supported video codecs.

methods.name: IsAudioEquivalenceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if audio equivalence is enabled.

methods.name: AudioModeHandler
methods.description: Static callback for audio mode change events.

methods.name: audiomodeChanged
methods.description: Notifies observers of audio mode changes.

methods.name: Mode
methods.description: Sets or gets Dolby output mode (not implemented).

methods.name: AtmosMetadata
methods.description: Checks if Atmos metadata is supported.

methods.name: UpdateAudioCodecInfo
methods.description: Populates supported audio codecs via GStreamer.

methods.name: UpdateVideoCodecInfo
methods.description: Populates supported video codecs via GStreamer.
